name: NBER Conference on the Economics of Community Colleges
organizer: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), with support from Ascendium Education Philanthropy
submission_requirements: Full papers or extended abstracts (explaining what the project will study and what data will be used) via the NBER submission system. Papers accepted for publication or expected to be published by Spring 2028 are not eligible; papers may not offer policy recommendations or normative judgments. Early-career scholars who are not NBER affiliates especially encouraged. NBER covers travel for one author per paper.
journal: Papers and discussant remarks to be published as an edited volume with the University of Chicago Press
